text: The Technical Disaster Risk Reduction (TDRR) Program, led by Geoscience Australia, is a comprehensive initiative aimed at enhancing disaster resilience in Papua New Guinea. It focuses on geohazards such as earthquakes, tsunamis, and volcanic activity. The program integrates community-based seismic monitoring with national hazard assessments and decision-support tools. It includes the deployment of low-cost sensors, the development of a centralized geohazards website, and capacity building through training and technical guidance. The program aligns with global disaster risk reduction frameworks and aims to improve local detection, situational awareness, and community engagement.
